title: Subagent start and stop leave ops rows
goal: SubagentStart and SubagentStop hook entries in .claude/settings.json and the plugin run querylog.py capture; distill turns each pair into one ops agent.run row with the agent group, a salted short hash of the agent id, the item (from the work/<id> branch) and the milliseconds between them; kbusage's agent list names kb-worker.

gates.question: This adds a mechanism before a failure it answers has happened (backlog.md, Changing this process). Add it anyway?

notes: SubagentStart can fire more than once for one agent id, so a start row is not a dispatch count. A worker is counted under other in kbusage today.
